info.title: GameAudioLab delivery service
info.description: Implemented /v1/audio service, not the legacy /api/audio prototype. Workflow: create plan -> verify and copy full confirmation -> submit with Idempotency-Key -> poll/cancel/retry -> verify immutable manifest/files -> decode locally and unlock playback after a user gesture. No audio is generated on a gameplay event. Unknown methods return 404, not 405. Request field strictness mirrors runtime: generation envelopes/delivery/items are strict; shared GameBrief/EventContract extension metadata is deliberately preserved. Tokens map to owners on the server; never send owner in a request. Loopback development without configured tokens uses local-development; non-loopback startup requires configured tokens. Browser clients must explicitly allowlist their Origin and use bearer credentials with credentials:omit. A reverse proxy may supply HTTPS; current same-origin CORS detection compares Origin to http://Host.

servers.description: Default loopback development server; authentication optional only when no service token is configured.

ServiceBearer.description: Operator-configured token mapped to an owner. Every resource is owner-isolated. No client-supplied owner, cookie authentication or token issuing endpoint. Required whenever tokens are configured, including health/capabilities.

GameBrief.description: Shared JSON game description; extension fields are preserved and affect briefHash. briefRevision is a legacy alias. If both revision fields exist they must agree. Text is trimmed, NFC-normalized and CRLF normalized before hashing.

GameEvent.description: Unknown event metadata is preserved and hashed. Missing/null cue means unmapped; required events must have a cue. IDs must be unique.

EventContract.description: Shared contract with extension metadata. Events and scenes are normalized and sorted; schemaVersion defaults to 1.

DeliveryRequest.description: Only declared fields are accepted. Formats are ordered by preference; each item uses the first accepted format unless overridden. Defaults are materialized in the returned Delivery.

Delivery.description: Fully normalized confirmation snapshot. Copy the complete returned object into jobs/retries; changing or omitting any property returns 409.

SpatialRequest.description: Mono SFX source with host-side HRTF distance panning when enabled. No occlusion, geometry or reverberation model. maxDistance >= refDistance. Spatial coordinates belong to playback events, not this generation request.

anyOf.description: Victory/failure support one variant. In synth mode ui/collect/laser/charge also support one; other cues support up to three.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Upper bound for the entire composed theme, not a trim request. The composed result must also be <=65 seconds.

MusicRequest.description: At most four slots. All slots in a plan share one composed theme; scene labels do not create independently composed songs. stems delivers exactly core/texture/rhythm; mix delivers one file.

anyOf.description: If omitted, mapped events become SFX and one required exploration/first-scene mix is added when scenes exist. Required event coverage and one SFX item per event are enforced.

PlanRequest.description: Maximum JSON body size 262144 bytes. Unsupported top-level fields are rejected; runtime functions or provider URLs cannot be supplied here.

SourcePlan.description: Source score/compiler contract, not an encoded media package. Its source planId is different from the outer delivery planId.

DeliveryPlan.description: Immutable owner-bound plan. planDigest is SHA-256 of canonical JSON excluding planId/planDigest/status. Object keys sort lexicographically; array order is preserved. Creating a plan does not render audio.

acceptedItems.description: Known plan item IDs. Required items must all be included. The service deduplicates and sorts this array.

ConfirmJobRequest.description: This POST confirms the exact plan/delivery and starts selected-only rendering. Identity and delivery must exactly match the plan. Required selection is enforced independently of JSON Schema.

acceptedItems.description: Known plan item IDs. Required items must all be included. The service deduplicates and sorts this array.

retryItems.description: If omitted, selects all retryable failed/cancelled components. Only incomplete terminal jobs can be retried; immutable ready components are reused.

RetryJobRequest.description: Repeat the original complete confirmation; returns a new linked job. Non-retryable failures cannot be selected. Existing published packages remain immutable.

anyOf.description: Alias of manifestUrl; there is no archive-download endpoint.

AudioJob.description: partial-ready is terminal. requiredReady and allSelectedReady have different meanings. A rendering job may expose an immutable partial package; later success updates the job URL to a new digest.

Loop.description: Frame interval [startFrame,endFrame), relative to the valid master at referenceSampleRate; endFrame must be > startFrame and within every referenced file.

path.description: Package-relative path. Request using the files base URL and URL-encode each path segment.

AudioFile.description: frames means effective valid master frames; decodedPcmBytes uses decoded frames * channels * 4, including decoder padding. Trim trailing padding once; container decoders already remove leading AAC priming. Only audio/ MIME files should be decoded.

path.description: Package-relative path. Request using the files base URL and URL-encode each path segment.

MediaManifest.description: The response is this object directly, with no manifest envelope. packageId = SHA-256(canonical JSON of all fields except packageId). File SHA-256 digests bind actual bytes. Transfer budget includes media and the two provenance files, excluding manifest/HTTP transport overhead. Technical pass does not claim listening or gameplay quality.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Running service capabilities. Positional playback is optional for explicitly spatial mono SFX and has no occlusion. The legacy source-only bridge is stereo-pan-only.
